title: Appledore Island Adventure
author: Leah Zarin
problems: Row 2 "star right 2 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A star of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.

Row 3 "partners allemande left ½, robins catch left in the middle to form short wavy lines · ocean-wave" can't start from where the dancers are: Both ends would take the same end of the wave; the hands named do not fit how the dancers face.
Row 4 "balance & Rory O'More right · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Neighbors in a wave must face opposite ways.
Row 4 "balance & Rory O'More right · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Neighbors in a wave must face opposite ways.
Row 5 "balance & Rory O'More left, partners catch right hands · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Neighbors in a wave must face opposite ways.
choices: Rory O'More spins one full turn in the travel direction.
The balance before each Rory steps toward the slide direction first.
Slice: half the counts on the diagonal, half straight back.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
A star with no grip named is a basket star (wrist grip).
